channel.title: Wholesale and retail: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the wholesale and retail sector.

item.title: DHX Company: DHX Company says the complainant withdrew the breach-of-trust complaint against all accused on November 17, 2026; the case is not formally closed.
Mgen Solutions: Mgen Solutions decides to issue KRW 10.0bn Series 26 private convertible bonds, convertible into 9,560,229 new common shares at KRW 1,046.
Wooyang P&L: Wooyang P&L reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 34.2bn and operating profit of KRW 3.5bn, provisional figures.
Hansaemk: Hansaemk resolves third-party allotment of 10,455,564 new shares at KRW 1,339 to majority shareholder in debt-to-equity conversion.
Phionx: PionEx amended its rights offering filing to set the final issue price at KRW 1,046, cutting new shares to 1,912,045.
item.description: Final issue price KRW 1,046 per share

item.title: Silicon 2: Siliconii terminated its KRW 5.0bn treasury share trust with Samsung Securities early on 13 Nov 2026 after completing its buyback.
GS Global: GS Global reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 1,077.7bn, up 14.0% YoY, with operating profit of KRW 3.9bn, down 39.0%.
E-mart: E-mart's October 2026 standalone net sales were KRW 1,398.4bn, down 3.5% year on year; gross sales fell 4.5%.
E-mart: E-Mart reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 7.49tn and operating profit of KRW 46.1bn, down 69.6% year on year.
Savezone I&C: Save Zone I&C reported Q3 2026 revenue of KRW 31.2bn and an operating loss of KRW 1.8bn, with a net loss of KRW 20.1bn.
Shinsegae International: Shinsegae International reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 299.5bn and operating profit of KRW 5.1bn, versus a loss a year earlier.
Incon: Incon signed a KRW 5.46bn LTE-R upgrade works contract with Korea Rail Network Authority, equal to 10.74% of revenue.
Hanssem: Hanssem's Q3 2026 preliminary consolidated revenue was KRW 357.6bn, down 19.0% year on year, with operating profit of KRW 1.6bn.
iMarketKorea: I'MarketKorea reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 1,075.7bn and operating profit of KRW 21.0bn, both up year on year.
SK Networks: SK Networks reported Q3 2026 preliminary consolidated revenue of KRW 1,935.7bn and operating profit of KRW 20.1bn, with a net loss of KRW 0.5bn.
SG: SG Semul Corp reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 36.8bn and an operating loss of KRW 1.2bn, with a net loss of KRW 1.0bn.
SK Gas: SK Gas completed its small-scale absorption merger of wholly owned subsidiary SK Advanced on November 4, 2026, issuing no new shares.
Hyundai Department Store: Hyundai Department Store reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 1.1723tn and operating profit of KRW 94.6bn, both up year on year.
LX International: LX International reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 5.19tn and operating profit of KRW 143.1bn, up 15.1% and 120.8% year on year.
LOTTE Himart: Lotte Himart's Q3 2026 standalone revenue was KRW 654.5bn and operating profit KRW 5.5bn, down 70.9% year on year.
Hyundai Green Food: Hyundai Green Food reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 652.0bn and operating profit of KRW 44.8bn.
KG Mobility Platform: KG Mobility Platform posted Q3 2026 revenue of KRW 480.4bn and operating profit of KRW 7.5bn, a turnaround from the prior quarter's loss.
